messages:
anya: kicking off canary - redwood-llm-v3-int8 -> route: /summarize, traffic 10% (canary id 20240321-int8-01). ran eval suite A on 1k prompts, latency ok, but hallucination-rate up ~3.5% vs baseline 0.8% :thinking_face:
raj: do we have request sampling bias? which prompt categories blew up?
matt: do we have the seed/trace for the failing ones? can we repro locally?
anya: mostly long-form legal & meeting-notes. short news summaries fine. pasting sample ids: 42,73,120 (will upload snippets).
matt: can you paste the gen config? temperature/best_of/top_p etc. quantization could interact with decoding.
anya: config: temperature=0.0, max_tokens=512, top_p=0.95, presence_penalty=0.0. quant: per-channel int8, group_size=128, calibration set=1k batches, per-layer symmetric. no prompt prefixes.
raj: hmm temp=0.0 should be deterministic. this smells like precision loss in attention accumulators for long contexts or kv-cache truncation rounding.
anya: eval-bot: automated regression check triggered -> metric: hallucination_rate delta +2.7% (p<0.01), rouge-L -0.6. breakdown attached: legal +5.8, meeting-notes +3.2, news -0.1.
deploy-bot: Canary 20240321-int8-01 started at 1719012345, traffic 10% -> processed 1,012 reqs so far.
matt: can we shadow-run int8 but capture fp16 reference outputs (quiet burn) for token-diff and semantic-diff? need 10k samples ideally.
anya: started shadow job quiet-burn qb-87 (10k target). streaming diffs to /tmp/qb-87. also reducing canary to 1% while investigating :slightly_frowning_face:
raj: proposal for auto-fallback: if hallucination_rate delta > 1.5% AND absolute hallucination_rate > 1.0% vs baseline on core prompt set -> immediate rollback. add hysteresis 15m and min_sample_count 500.
matt: +1. also add rule: if top-5 worst regressions include any high-sev legal prompt (tagged in eval set) -> immediate rollback regardless of global metric.
anya: agree. I'll codify policy and push to rollout config. also trying targeted calibration (per-layer bias correction) and reclibrate using stratified samples from legal/meeting categories.
eval-bot: summary: smoke FAILED. action items: (1) run qb-87 to completion and produce token-level divergence report, (2) add per-category calibration, (3) update canary gating thresholds per proposal, (4) re-run 5k sample sanity check before any promote. tagging @eng-oncall for visibility.
anya: thanks all — will post qb-87 interim diffs here when available. :thumbsup:
